name: Dating Age
overview: Scripture reveals that God created companionship as a fundamental need for man, providing a suitable helper to complete him, as seen in Genesis 2:18. The union of marriage is established by God’s design for a man to leave his parents and unite with his wife, becoming one flesh (Genesis 2:24). Wisdom and prudence in choosing a spouse are emphasized, recognizing a godly wife as a blessing from the Lord (Proverbs 19:14). Believers are encouraged to guard their hearts diligently (Proverbs 4:23) and delight in the Lord, trusting Him to fulfill the desires of their hearts (Psalms 37:4), including the desire for companionship and family.
